description: Format, analyze, and test FocusFlow before completing a turn.

hooks.command: root="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$root/.codex/hooks/qa.sh" ] && [ "$root" != / ]; do root=$(dirname "$root"); done; bash "$root/.codex/hooks/qa.sh"
hooks.statusMessage: Formatting, checking analyzers, and running tests. BLOCKING: errors must be fixed before continuing.
